{{nihongo|'''Yana Shrine'''|山那神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

=== History ===
Its founding period is unknown.

It is said that this shrine is the inner-shrine Yana Shrine in the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}'' and “Junior Third Rank Yana Tenjin” in the provincial register. In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} ({{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 5), it was ranked village shrine under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}}. In {{ill|1897|Q7847|qid=Q7847}} (Meiji 30), Tenjin-sha was renamed Yana Shrine, and in {{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}} (Meiji 40) it received official-offering designation. On {{ill|November 13|Q2984|qid=Q2984}}, {{ill|1911|Q2076|qid=Q2076}} (Meiji 44), Aoki-sha in Aza Ōmochi was merged.

In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, this shrine stood on a midstream island in the {{ill|Kiso River|Q779607|qid=Q779607}}, but in the great flood of {{ill|1601|Q6725|qid=Q6725}} ({{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 6), houses, temples/shrines, and fields were all washed away, so the shrine was moved into the precinct of the subsidiary Shinmei-sha south of the levee. During that flood, the main shrine image drifted as far as Kōmyōji village in {{ill|Haguri District|Q1032507|qid=Q1032507}} (present {{ill|Kōmyoji|Q127442823|qid=Q127442823|lt=Kōmyōji}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|Q270810|qid=Q270810}}), where villagers recovered it and worshiped it in the precinct of the Tendai temple Kōmyōji. Villagers of Yana repeatedly sought its return, and it is said to have been returned on February 8, {{ill|1869|ab|1869|af|1869|als|1869|am|1869 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1869|ar|1869|ary|1869|arz|1869|ast|1869|avk|1869|az|1869|azb|۱۸۶۹ (میلادی)|ba|1869 йыл|ban|1869|bar|1869|bat_smg|1869|bcl|1869|be|1869|be_x_old|1869|bg|1869|bn|১৮৬৯|bpy|মারি ১৮৬৯|br|1869|bs|1869.|ca|1869|cdo|1869 nièng|ce|1869 шо|ceb|1869|ckb|١٨٦٩|crh|1869|cs|1869|csb|1869|cv|1869|cy|1869|da|1869|de|1869|diq|1869|el|1869|eml|1869|eo|1869|es|1869|et|1869|eu|1869|fa|۱۸۶۹|fi|1869|fiu_vro|1869|fo|1869|fr|1869|frp|1869|frr|1869|fur|1869|fy|1869|ga|1869|gan|1869年|gcr|1869|gd|1869|gl|1869|gn|1869|gv|1869|he|1869|hi|१८६९|hif|1869|hr|1869.|hsb|1869|ht|1869 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1869|hy|1869|hyw|1869 թուական|ia|1869|id|1869|ilo|1869|io|1869|is|1869|it|1869|ja|1869年|jbo|1869moi|jv|1869|ka|1869|kaa|1869|kk|1869 жыл|kn|೧೮೬೯|ko|1869년|krc|1869 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1869|ku|1869|kv|1869-ӧд во|la|1869|lb|1869|lez|1869 йис|li|1869|lij|1869|lmo|1869|lt|1869 m.|lv|1869. gads|mai|१८६९|map_bms|1869|mdf|1869|mg|1869|mhr|1869|mi|1869|min|1869|mk|1869|mn|1869 он|mr|इ.स. १८६९|mrj|1869 и|ms|1869|my|၁၈၆၉|myv|1869 ие|mzn|۱۸۶۹|nah|1869|nap|1869|nds|1869|nds_nl|1869|new|ई सं १८६९|nl|1869|nn|1869|no|1869|nrm|1869|nso|1869|oc|1869|olo|1869|or|୧୮୬୯|os|1869-æм аз|pa|1869|pap|1869|pl|1869|pnb|1869|pt|1869|qu|1869|ro|1869|ru|1869 год|rue|1869|sa|१८६९|sah|1869|scn|1869|sco|1869|sd|1869ع|se|1869|sh|1869.|shn|1869|simple|1869|sk|1869|sl|1869|smn|1869|sq|1869|sr|1869|stq|1869|su|1869|sv|1869|sw|1869|szl|1869|ta|1869|te|1869|tet|1869|tg|Соли 1869|th|พ.ศ. 2412|tk|1869|tl|1869|tly|1869|tr|1869|tt|1869 ел|udm|1869 ар|uk|1869|ur|1869ء|uz|1869|vec|1869|vi|1869|vls|1869|vo|1869|wa|1869|war|1869|wuu|1869年|xmf|1869|yi|1869|za|1869 nienz|zea|1869|zh|1869年|zh_classical|一八六九年|zh_min_nan|1869 nî|zh_yue|1869年|qid=Q7720}} (Meiji 2). This gave rise to the legend of “Kōmyōji-nagare.”

=== Site of Aoki Shrine ===
West of Ryūsen-ji in Yana there was Aoki Shrine enshrining Susanoo-no-Mikoto. During {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shinbutsu-konko}}, Ryūsen-ji and Aoki Shrine are thought to have been one body; in {{ill|1820|Q6973|qid=Q6973}} ({{ill|Bunsei|Q1327119|qid=Q1327119}} 3), it separated from the temple and was reportedly restored as Aoki Shrine at the time of the {{ill|Meiji Restoration|Q8707|qid=Q8707}}. On November 13, 1911, it was merged into Yana Shrine. The former site is now Yamana Nursery School, with a stone marker in one corner. Place names such as Aoki and Aoki-mae remain nearby.

=== Site of Tenjin Shrine ===
Near the old shrine site are place names such as Ōtorii-guchi, Miyuki-michi, Magusa-yama, Tenjin-yama, and Tenjin-mae, thought to date from when Tenjin Shrine was enshrined.
{{See also|北山名村}}

=== Location ===
* 609 Yashikichi, Ōaza Yana, Niwa District, Fusō, Aichi Prefecture
**About 900 m northeast of {{ill|Fusō Municipal Yamana Elementary School|Q81976214|qid=Q81976214}}. South of the {{ill|Migoi levee|Q11488847|qid=Q11488847}} on the {{ill|Kiso River|Q779607|qid=Q779607}}.

=== Transportation ===
*About 30 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kotsuyōsui Station|Q6434256|qid=Q6434256}} on the {{ill|Meitetsu Inuyama Line|Q6810411|qid=Q6810411}}.
*About 45 minutes on foot from {{ill|Fusō Station|Q5510430|qid=Q5510430}} on the same line.
